liquidGlass.name: Liquid Glass
liquidGlass.description: Refractive glass instruments with hybrid, turbo, temperatures and component warnings. Refraction supports native DX9/10/11/12 and Vulkan when the game backdrop is available.

tooltip.showDamage: Show supported engine, cooling, gearbox and tyre indicators.
tooltip.showTurbo: Show measured turbo pressure when the game reports it.
tooltip.showTemperatures: Show reported coolant and oil temperatures.
tooltip.glassRefraction: Edge displacement in dashboard pixels. Requires native in-game rendering and a readable game backdrop.
tooltip.glassBlur: Background diffusion in dashboard pixels. Requires native in-game rendering and a readable game backdrop.
tooltip.glassEnabled: Apply refraction to this dashboard’s panels. Disable to skip its backdrop capture and glass shader. Unsupported surfaces use a translucent tint.
tooltip.glassOpacity: Panel tint from transparent (0) to opaque (1); applies to the fallback too.
